about: One picture per line of script.json, shown in the demo video while that line is spoken. A line whose voice starts with "+" is spoken over the line before it and keeps that line's picture, so it has null here. Make the pictures with an image model that takes reference pictures (for example GPT Image in ChatGPT): print the prompts with `uv run python scripts/demo/make_pictures_prompts.py OUT.md ep01` (the demo has pictures for ep01 only), then save picture N of an episode as PICTURES/ep01/NN.png and run `uv run python scripts/demo/add_pictures.py EPISODES PICTURES`. The characters must be drawn from the project's official illustrations (https://zunko.jp/con_illust.html): its Q&A allows AI pictures based on them, under the character guidelines (https://zunko.jp/guideline.html), and not based on other people's fan art.
style: Japanese TV anime screenshot, school slice-of-life comedy. Clean line art, soft cel shading, bright warm colors, gentle afternoon light, slightly blurred detailed background. Wholesome and cheerful. Landscape 3:2 picture; keep every face and the main action inside the middle band, because the top and bottom 8% will be cut off to make a 16:9 video frame. No subtitles, no speech bubbles, no captions, no watermark, no UI. No written text anywhere unless the shot asks for it.
framing: Output exactly 1536x1024 pixels. Keep every face, head accessory, raised hand and the main gesture between y=128 and y=896, with some background above the tallest head accessory: the top and bottom are cut off for a 16:9 video frame. No written words anywhere, not even on the chalkboard, paper, notebooks, signs or calculator keys.

characters.zunda: ずんだもん: a small edamame fairy, not a human student; about half the height of the girls. Speaks in a cheeky, proud way.
characters.metan: 四国めたん: a 17-year-old high school girl, the class's organized and slightly bossy leader, secretly kind.
characters.sora: 九州そら: a 17-year-old high school girl, calm, gentle and cheerful; the peacemaker.
characters.usagi: 中国うさぎ: a 14-year-old girl who skipped grades into this class; shy, polite, good at drawing.
characters.tsurugi: 中部つるぎ: an 18-year-old girl, the one who counts money; serious, a little anxious.

rules: Draw each character exactly as in their reference picture: same face, hair, eye color, outfit and accessories, at every angle. Do not add characters who are not named in the shot. The speaker is in focus and clearly visible, face toward the camera or three-quarter view, mouth open as if talking.

scenes.classroom: A Japanese high school classroom in the morning: wooden desks pushed together, a green chalkboard, big windows with sunlight. Paper, pens and a notebook on the desks.
scenes.supermarket: A bright Japanese supermarket after school: aisles of shelves, a frozen food section with glass doors, a red shopping basket.
scenes.cafe: The same classroom turned into a school-festival café for the day: desks covered with gingham tablecloths, paper flower decorations and paper chains, a small counter with a blender and a tray of green zunda mochi. At the entrance stands a hand-painted wooden sign that reads 「ずんだ喫茶」 (this is the only written text allowed).
scenes.cleanup: The same festival café in the late afternoon, half tidied: orange sunset light through the windows, decorations being taken down, chairs stacked.
